plugins.name: evidence-discovery
plugins.description: Discovers a repository's technology stack, deployment stack, toolchain, design system and agreed test strategy, and writes them to .evidence/context/ so every other skill reads facts instead of assuming them. Never guesses — asks.

plugins.name: evidence-sdlc
plugins.description: The Evidence Chain control plane: a fail-closed gate engine (plan approval, claims, tier floors, change control, test protection, secrets, protected pushes and releases), lifecycle state, human-only approval, a hash-chained audit log, the `evidence` CLI, review agents and skills.

plugins.name: evidence-quality
plugins.description: Test strategy, test-case authoring into the test management system, automation, E2E UI (Playwright/Selenium/Cypress), accessibility, performance (load/stress/soak/spike), security testing, static analysis, continuous testing, and the traceability ID chain that links tracker to test case to commit to evidence.

plugins.name: evidence-compliance
plugins.description: Regulatory controls for regulated records and the derivation of validation deliverables from the artifact chain.

plugins.name: evidence-integrations
plugins.description: Third-party and partner integration change management: contracts, versioning, sandboxes, contract tests, failure modes and the regulated-record implications of data leaving the platform.

metadata.description: Evidence Chain: AI-native SDLC controls for teams that must prove what they shipped — gates that run when the agent acts, human-only approval, traceability and audit evidence.
